method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Aged Care Act 2024 (Cth), Compilation No. 2, compilation date 1 July 2026 (includes amendments up to Act No. 45, 2025), register id C2026C00301, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2024A00104.txt. The Aged Care Rules 2025 are not deposited; every number they set is an input.

scope: The older person seeking care: who can apply and be found eligible for an aged care needs assessment (age 65, or 50 for Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander people and the homeless; ss 7, 56, 58, 61, 62); Support at Home (home support) or residential care by place and approval (ss 8, 10, 65-68); priority categories (ss 84, 86(5)); whether funded home support can start now (s 9(2), ss 92(1A), 92A); backdating (s 71); revocation on request and notice periods; the Support at Home individual contribution and the lifetime cap (s 273); the daily means tested amount (s 319); residential basic daily fee, hotelling and non-clinical care contributions, pre-entry and bed reservation fees (ss 276-282); accommodation payment or contribution, interest, minimum assets (ss 296, 298, 301, 305); the Statement of Rights and where to complain (ss 23, 24, 358). Out: supporters, classification, place numbers, specialist programs, subsidies, provider regulation, review, penalties.
lives: chloe c097 (2085): a Support at Home package after an aged care assessment
